gloss: within Tokyo; inside the Tokyo metropolitan area

definitions.gloss: within Tokyo; inside the Tokyo metropolitan area
definitions.explanation: Refers to areas within the boundaries of Tokyo-to (東京都). Commonly used in news, real estate, and everyday conversation to specify that something is located in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {都内|とない}に{住|す}んでいる。
{都内|とない}のホテルを{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I booked a hotel in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {都内|とない}の{家賃|やちん}は{年々|ねんねん}{上|あ}がっている。
examples.english: Rents in Tokyo have been rising year after year.

notes:
Specifically refers to within the Tokyo metropolitan area ({東京都|とうきょうと}), including the 23 special wards and the wider Tama area.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {都内|とない}に{住|す}む: to live in Tokyo
- {都内|とない}の{学校|がっこう}: a school in Tokyo
- {都内|とない}で{働|はたら}く: to work in Tokyo
- {都内|とない}の{病院|びょういん}: a hospital in Tokyo

PATTERN:
Follows the same area + {内|ない} pattern as:
- {市内|しない}: within a city
- {県内|けんない}: within a prefecture
- {国内|こくない}: within the country

USAGE:
Very common in news, real estate listings, and daily conversation. {都内|とない} is specific to Tokyo; for other prefectures, use {県内|けんない}, {府内|ふない} (Osaka/Kyoto), or {道内|どうない} (Hokkaido).
